entities.summary: Camillo Michael Gonsalves is a Vincentian politician, lawyer and diplomat and a son of former long-term Prime Minister Ralph Gonsalves. He served as Minister of Finance, Economic Planning and Information Technology of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines during the premiership of his father and additionally sat in the House of Assembly as the representative for the constituency of East St. George from 2015 to 2025.
